paragraphs.text: 1. SAVITAR fixed the earth with bands to bind it, and made heaven steadfast where no prop supported.
Savitar milked, as 'twere a restless courser, air, sea bound fast to what no foot had trodden.
2. Well knoweth Savitar, O Child of Waters, where ocean, firmly fixt, o'erflowed its limit.
paragraphs.original: यत्रा समुद्र स्कभितो व्यौनदपां नपात्सविता तस्य वेद ।
paragraphs.translit: yatrā samudra skabhito vyaunadapāṃ napātsavitā tasya veda |

paragraphs.text: Thence sprang the world, from that uprose the region: thence heaven spread out and the wide earth expanded.
paragraphs.original: अतो भूरत आ उत्थितं रजोऽतो द्यावापृथिवी अप्रथेताम्
paragraphs.translit: ato bhūrata ā utthitaṃ rajo'to dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām

paragraphs.text: 3. Then, with a full crowd of Immortal Beings, this other realm came later, high and holy.
First, verily, Savitar's strong-pinioned Eagle was born: and he obeys his law for ever.
paragraphs.original: सुपर्णो अङ्ग सवितुर्गरुत्मान्पूर्वो जातः स उ अस्यानु धर्म
paragraphs.translit: suparṇo aṅga saviturgarutmānpūrvo jātaḥ sa u asyānu dharma

paragraphs.text: 4. As warriors to their steeds, kine to their village, as fond milk giving cows approach their youngling,
paragraphs.original: गाव इव ग्रामं यूयुधिरिवाश्वान्वाश्रेव वत्सं सुमना दुहाना ।
paragraphs.translit: gāva iva grāmaṃ yūyudhirivāśvānvāśreva vatsaṃ sumanā duhānā |

paragraphs.text: As man to wife, let Savitar come downward to us, heaven's bearer, Lord of every blessing.
paragraphs.original: पतिरिव जायामभि नो न्येतु धर्ता दिवः सविता विश्ववारः
paragraphs.translit: patiriva jāyāmabhi no nyetu dhartā divaḥ savitā viśvavāraḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Like the Angirasa Hiranvastupa, I call thee, Savitar, to this achievement:
paragraphs.original: हिरण्यस्तूपः सवितर्यथा त्वाङ्गिरसो जुह्वे वाजे अस्मिन् ।
paragraphs.translit: hiraṇyastūpaḥ savitaryathā tvāṅgiraso juhve vāje asmin |

paragraphs.text: So worshipping and lauding thee for favour I watch for thee as for the stalk of Soma.
paragraphs.original: एवा त्वार्चन्नवसे वन्दमानः सोमस्येवांशुं प्रति जागराहम्
paragraphs.translit: evā tvārcannavase vandamānaḥ somasyevāṃśuṃ prati jāgarāham
